title: Splash World Cup 2026
description: We're celebrating the soccer championship in Splash! All our games (including Impostor Game) are getting brand new World Cup 26 categories. New game! We're currently developing a brand new game with a World Cup championship theme. We've got even more planned in the app, like a raffle and soccer-themed game cards, so World Cup 26 in Splash is going to be amazing! We'd love to show this off to the world and make even more people happy playing Splash with their friends. We're super proud of our 4.8 rating from over 200,000 users!
